name: Joe's Barbershop
address: 723 E Bradley Ave, Suite C, El Cajon CA 92021
quote: Best $30 haircut in East County. Every time.
differentiator: No-frills traditional barbershop. Appointments recommended, walk-ins as available, cash only at the chair, ATM on site. Family-friendly. The $30 base price is the East County value anchor.

name: Ducky's Barber Shop
address: 941 Broadway, Ste L, El Cajon CA 92021
quote: Tapered me up, hot towel shave and best of all made me feel welcomed and at home.
differentiator: Appointment-only traditional shop in Bostonia. Highest review count in East County (237 Yelp). Open Sundays. Specializes in hot towel straight razor shaves.

name: Clipper Crew Barber Shop
address: 700 N Johnson Ave, Ste B, El Cajon CA 92020
quote: Just got my haircut by J and honestly this was one of the best cuts I've ever had.
differentiator: Walk-ins welcome, extended hours daily (open until 9–10pm). Accepts credit cards and Zelle. Modern shop positioned for after-work and weekend walk-in traffic.

name: Artists Barber Shop
address: 433 E Main St, El Cajon CA 92020
quote: Coming from LA down to SD I was skeptical trying out a new barber.
differentiator: Full-service downtown El Cajon shop open 7 days a week. Offers razor shaves, threading, hair coloring, and beard dye alongside standard cuts. Walk-ins welcome.
